title: RHealthTwin: Towards Responsible and Multimodal Digital Twins for Personalized Well-being

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated healthcare recommendations using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4) to score outputs against a WHO-Aligned Responsibility Rubric (WRR), which includes 'Fairness' as a core criterion to assess the mitigation of demographic biases and the promotion of equity and inclusiveness.
